title: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs introduce AlphaFold 3, a model for biomolecular structure and interactions
summary: The model predicts the structure and interactions of proteins, DNA, RNA and other biomolecules.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o, a multimodal model for text, audio and images
summary: OpenAI presented GPT-4o in a livestreamed demonstration led by its chief technology officer Mira Murati.

title: Reports say Google's AI gave confidently incorrect and harmful information to users
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports that a Google AI system gave confidently incorrect and harmful answers.

title: Google begins rolling out AI-generated search summaries to US users
summary: AI Overviews started appearing in Google Search results for users in the United States.

title: Stanford's Foundation Model Transparency Index v1.1 scores 14 developers; the average rises from 37 to 58 of 100
summary: The assessment, conducted in May 2024, scored 14 foundation model developers on 100 indicators, with individual scores from 33 to 85.

title: Council of Europe adopts Framework Convention on AI and human rights, democracy and the rule of law
summary: The Council of Europe adopted the first international treaty text on AI covering human rights, democracy and the rule of law.

title: OpenAI dissolves its Superalignment team after Sutskever and Leike leave; Leike criticises safety priorities
summary: Ilya Sutskever resigned, followed by Jan Leike, who publicly criticised the company's safety priorities, and OpenAI spread the team's members across other groups.

title: Reports say Meta AI chatbots joined online support communities without being invited
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports of Meta chatbots entering support groups uninvited.

title: OpenAI pauses its Sky voice; Scarlett Johansson says she had declined to license her voice
summary: OpenAI disabled the Sky voice while it addressed questions about how voices were chosen, and Johansson said the next day that she had declined OpenAI's offers to license her voice.

title: AI Seoul Summit opens; leaders of the US, UK, EU, Japan and others adopt the Seoul Declaration on safe AI
summary: The 21 and 22 May summit, co-hosted by South Korea and the UK, produced a declaration adopted by leaders of the EU, US, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, South Korea and Singapore.

title: California Senate passes SB 1047, a safety bill for large AI models, 32 to 1
summary: SB 1047 passed the state Senate by 32 votes to 1.

title: EU Council approves the Artificial Intelligence Act
summary: On 21 May 2024 the Council of the European Union approved the AI Act.

title: Reports say a US Veterans Affairs suicide-prevention algorithm prioritised men over women veterans
summary: The REACH VET algorithm reportedly ranked male veterans above female veterans for outreach.

title: xAI raises USD 6 billion in a Series B round at a USD 24 billion post-money valuation
summary: The round valued xAI at USD 18 billion before the money and USD 24 billion after it.

title: Yandex launches the third generation of its lightweight model YandexGPT Lite
summary: Yandex launched the third generation of YandexGPT Lite on 28 May 2024.

title: Reports say US-born John Mark Dougan, based in Russia, spread disinformation with AI tools and a fake news network
summary: Dougan, an American asylum seeker in Russia, reportedly used AI tools and a network of fake news sites to spread disinformation.

title: Deepfake falsely shows US State Department spokesman Matthew Miller suggesting Belgorod could be attacked with US weapons
summary: A deepfake video of spokesman Matthew Miller circulated with a false claim about attacks on the Russian city of Belgorod.

title: Japanese PM Kishida launches the Hiroshima AI Process Friends Group at the OECD, joined by 49 countries and regions
summary: In an OECD speech Kishida proposed an international framework for generative AI rules based on the Hiroshima AI Process and called for cooperation with Southeast Asia.

title: DeepSeek releases open-weight DeepSeek-V2, a 236B-parameter MoE model, with API prices of 1 yuan per million input tokens
summary: The low pricing, about one-hundredth of GPT-4 Turbo according to Chinese media, set off a price war among Chinese model providers.

title: Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute releases Falcon 2, an open-source 11B model including a vision-language version
summary: TII, a government-backed research centre, published Falcon 2 11B models under an open licence.

title: China and the US hold their first intergovernmental dialogue on AI in Geneva
summary: Officials from both governments discussed AI risks and governance, a meeting agreed by Presidents Xi and Biden in November 2023.

title: South Korea announces a KRW 26 trillion support package for its semiconductor industry, including a KRW 18.1 trillion financing programme
summary: Finance Minister Choi Sang-mok said the package of loans, tax credits and infrastructure aid would be spent over three years.

title: China sets up the third phase of its National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund with registered capital of 344 billion yuan
summary: The six largest state banks contribute about one-third of the capital of the state-backed chip fund.
